description:
## Problem
The host lock is taken only by parallel pytest sessions (`_wants_parallel_lock`, `_benchbox_pytest_xdist_safety.py:96-102`; `_should_acquire_test_lock`, `tests/conftest.py:124-135`). The heaviest local runs are serial and take no lock: `test-slow`, `test-stress`, `test-correctness-gate`, `test-local-matrix`, `tpcds-obt-equivalence`, `test-required-local-cases`, `plan-capture-gate`, `test-docker-%`, `test-live-gizmosql` (Makefile:117,121,133,142,306,318,362; make/platform-tests.mk:60,103,170). UAT (`tests/uat/_cli.py`) has no host lock at all. Locking every pytest session is not acceptable: `docs/agent/dev-loop-worktrees.md:240-244` promises `pr-preflight` never waits on the lock, tests encode that (`tests/unit/test_session_isolation.py:237,448`), and ~15 concurrent agent sessions would push people to the bypass.

## Change
1. pytest: keep the `-n>0` rule. A serial controller session also acquires when the collected, selected items include a marker in {slow, stress, resource_heavy, live_integration, docker_integration} or any `live_*` marker. Decide after collection in the controller (e.g. `pytest_collection_finish`), before the first test runs. xdist workers and owner-verified descendants never acquire.
2. Every acquiring pytest session runs admission and the watchdog from `heavy-guard-admission-20261030` and `heavy-guard-watchdog-20261030`.
3. UAT: in the `tests/uat/_cli.py` dispatcher, define an explicit light set {preflight, gate-check, report, replay-classify, package, validate, verify-tuning-matrix, docker-cleanup}; every other subcommand (cell, sweep, stress, execute and any future one) acquires the lock, admission and watchdog for the command lifetime, except `--dry-run`.
4. Make sure environment construction for UAT cell subprocesses and nested `benchbox run`/pytest preserves `BENCHBOX_TEST_SESSION_OWNER`, so children inherit instead of deadlocking. Where a call site builds env from scratch (e.g. `tests/unit/test_standardized_test_commands.py:146-151`), pass the owner var or point it at a tmp lock dir.
5. Update `tests/README.md` lock section to the new rule.

## Decision gates
- D1 (resolved): serial sessions lock only when heavy markers are selected; `pr-preflight` and targeted fast/medium runs keep the never-wait promise.
- G1 (stop condition): before coding, list the pytest invocations inside `make pr-preflight` and whether any selects heavy-marked tests serially. If one does, stop and record the conflict with the never-wait contract instead of silently changing it.
- G2 (stop condition): if deciding after collection makes a heavy session hold isolation state (HOME swap) that conflicts with late acquisition, record the constraint and choose acquisition in `pytest_collection_finish` only if all existing `test_session_isolation.py` contract tests stay green unmodified.

## Guardrails
- Linked worktree; stage explicitly; `[COMMENT-POLICY-001]`.
- Do not run the heavy suites for verification; use synthetic test files marked `slow`/`stress` in tmp dirs with a tmp lock dir.
- Do not change marker definitions in `pytest.ini` or reclassify existing tests.

## Non-goals
`benchbox` CLI acquisition, container/VM call sites, docs outside tests/README.md.
